purpose: Canonical XX clean-room takeover package for the user-owned NOVA economic/crypto operating system. It inventories the contract, chain controls, provider mesh, runtime tools, testnet deployment, and production launch gates so Nova can operate the crypto project as one governed system.

handoff.operation: Nova operates the replicated crypto system through its existing runtime/governance controls; no second controller is created.
handoff.externalEffects: Production chain writes, liquidity, listings, account changes and paid provider actions remain authority-gated.

system.revenueRule: Only verified commercial transactions count as Factory revenue; token holdings or market value do not.

provider_mesh: Coinbase CDP Sepolia faucet/EVM account capabilities
governance_and_safety: Private keys never stored in source-control artifacts
Owner locked to authorized treasury address
No hidden transfer tax, blacklist, honeypot or arbitrary confiscation
No fabricated deployment, balance, liquidity or revenue evidence

tools.purpose: chain ID, balance and on-chain verification
Ethereum Sepolia RPC, balances, blocks, receipts and data capabilities
authorized Sepolia faucet and EVM account capability
independent Nova execution and deployment orchestration
controlled local device execution under Nova policy

requirements: authorized mainnet signer for the configured owner
productionGates.rule: Nova may prepare and verify these gates but must not self-grant missing authority, fabricate funding or deploy a production financial asset without the required authorization.

successCriteria: read-only Sepolia chain probe succeeds when network access is available
no unsupported production success is inferred

securityBoundary.thirdPartyBoundary: For external companies/services, use public observable behavior and independent implementations; do not copy proprietary code, private data, credentials or protected branding.
securityBoundary.secretsPolicy: Manifest contains capability references and public configuration only; never private keys, wallet seeds, OAuth refresh tokens, API secret values or exchange credentials.
